Real design pressure, MAWP, pipe spec, length, elevation profile and actual PSV-101 set/blowdown/capacity: Time to design and required relief rate scale with volume and set - determines if existing PSV-101 is enough or larger orifice needed
Actual heat leak at sound and degraded vacuum: If worst exceeds 30 W/m, design reached <26 h; if <2 W/m, trajectory shifts but conclusion - no block-in without relief - unchanged
Liquid fill before isolation and effectiveness of drain/purge: Decides whether drained-to-gas alternative is credible; any residual LNG still gives rapid hydraulic pressurisation
XV-101/XV-102 leak-tightness and interlock logic: If valves pass, vented alternative fails - then PSV in service is the only acceptable barrier
